messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99 detector fired for route /v1/generate (us-west-2). p99 = 1.22s over the last 2m, p95 climbing. SLO breach triggered. paging on-call.
elena: ack — taking initial triage. can someone post the SLO dashboard link?
samir: https://dash.redwood/slo/latency#/route=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate — looks like a sharp tail increase ~10:04 UTC. p50 stable, p95 up ~200ms, p99 spike to 1.2s. :eyes:
elena: thanks. mira you on infra?
mira: on it. checking node pool and autoscaler. infra-bot: recent pool events: scale_up 10:03->10:05 (added 2 nodes), deployment rolling_redeploy model-serving-v3 at 09:58.
devon: any recent model rollout? I saw a canary pushed last hour to 10%.
elena: yes devon, can you confirm model variant and config? which quantization? any KV cache changes?
devon: canary = gpt-open-v3-int8, kvcache enabled, batch_size target 64. Canary only on 10% traffic via router policy.
elena: ok. quick checks: 1) is the canary traffic concentrated in us-west-2? 2) are streaming stalls / socket hangs visible? 3) any queue/backpressure on frontend?
samir: query from datadog: 
```
avg(last_5m):trace.latency{route:v1/generate,region:us-west-2}.rollup(p99)
```
shows the spike coincident with canary ramp (~10:00). also worker error rate +0.3% (decode timeouts).
mira: host metrics: CPU stable, GPU util per node ~65-85% on the new nodes. but one new node has repeated OOM-kill of process 'model-server' 3x at 10:02-10:04.
infra-bot: Collecting kube logs from pod model-server-xy12...
infra-bot: ```
OOMKilled at 10:03:12
stack: runtime allocation failed: unable to allocate 1.8GB
...
``` 
elena: that OOM could explain tail latency — retries + cold-restores. mira can you cordon that node and drain? mark as degraded.
mira: cordoned node, draining. scaling to add replacement. forced pod restart on redistributed nodes.
samir: tracing shows some requests hit pods with high swap and then retried -> p99 high. also streaming stalls visible in websocket connection logs: many chunk delays > 500ms. snippet:
```
[10:03:05] ws/conn/abcd chunk_delay=732ms route=/v1/generate
```
devon: canary config tweak: int8 backend has a different kernel selection causing occasional higher memory transient. reverting canary to previous variant now.
elena: do it and watch p99. if revert reduces p99, keep canary paused and investigate memory footprint.
devon: rollback initiated -> router set canary=0 at 10:08. verifying.
samir: after rollback, p99 dropped to 420ms by 10:11. p95 back to normal. looks correlated.
elena: good. mitigation summary: 1) rollback canary 2) cordon + replace OOM node 3) temporarily increase model-serving replica memory limit for safe margin 4) enable per-route fallback to smaller/lighter model for streaming routes.
mira: increasing memory limit on deployment to +1.5GB and applying a patch to kube OOM eviction thresholds.
infra-bot: autoscaler adjusted: added replacement node id=node-usw2-08 at 10:09.
elena: customer impact: routed customers in us-west-2 experienced higher p99 and occasional streaming stalls for ~6 minutes (10:03-10:09). No data plane errors, just latency; no API 5xx spike. we should notify SRE lead and account execs for any customers exceeding SLA.
samir: creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem to devon/mira. I’ll page account ops for customers with p99>1s.
devon: adding follow-up items: reproduce memory spike on local, run longer load tests on int8 kernels, add canary throttling and mem-safety checks, add alert for pod OOM events tied to route impact.
mira: will add node health monitors and make cordon/drain playbook explicit in runbook.
elena: nice triage. final checks: any other regions affected?
samir: no, only us-west-2 routing group. fallback routing prevented global impact.
elena: great. stand down on-call unless anything else surfaces. create follow-up incident note and schedule 1-hr bridge to review root cause and rollout safeguards.
mira: adding notes to incident ticket and marking page resolved.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=SEV3, mitigation_time=10:11. Postmortem owners=[devon,mira], follow-up meeting scheduled.
